canonical_name: COBOL Programming Course (Open Mainframe Project / IBM, 2020-): CBL0001..CBL0014, PAYROL00 -- real mainframe COBOL with EBCDIC packed-decimal data, run under GnuCOBOL 3
lineage: The business-computing culture as it still runs: fixed-format COBOL (IDENTIFICATION/ENVIRONMENT/DATA/PROCEDURE divisions, PICTURE clauses, COMP-3 packed decimal, FD/SELECT/ASSIGN to JCL DDNAMEs), reading a 170-byte fixed-record EBCDIC account file and writing a formatted report. Written for z/OS; here compiled by GnuCOBOL 3.1.2 with DDNAME-to-file mapping through the environment. Chosen after the NIST COBOL-85 validation suite (newcob.val) proved UNAVAILABLE at its origin (see the batch report: ORIGIN_UNAVAILABLE).
version: github.com/openmainframeproject/cobol-programming-course master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes); Course #2 Labs/cbl + Labs/data

license.evidence: LICENSE; SPDX header in each program

language: COBOL (IBM Enterprise COBOL dialect, fixed format)
dependencies: GnuCOBOL; the EBCDIC data file Labs/data/data (170-byte fixed records, COMP-3 fields)
entry_points: Labs/cbl/CBL0001.cobol (read ACCTREC, write PRTLINE); CBL0002..CBL0014 (headers, totals, conditionals, PERFORM); PAYROL00.cobol; SRCHBIN/SRCHSER (SEARCH ALL vs SEARCH)

example.command: cobc -x -free? no: fixed format; cobc -x CBL0001.cobol; DD_ACCTREC=../data/data DD_PRTLINE=out.txt ./CBL0001
example.output: a report whose packed-decimal limits/balances format as $ amounts (encoding-independent) while EBCDIC names appear untranslated -- recorded as such

upstream_docs: Open Mainframe Project, COBOL Programming Course (the course PDF in the tree)

human_capability_summary.built_to: process fixed-format business records -- accounts, balances, limits, payroll -- in batch and print formatted reports, exactly as mainframe shops have since the 1960s
human_capability_summary.pressure: decades-old data formats (EBCDIC, packed decimal) that must keep working; auditability of money arithmetic (decimal, not float)
human_capability_summary.success_means: every record read, every amount formatted exactly (PICTURE editing), totals correct to the cent

human_environmental_pressure: format longevity, exact decimal arithmetic, regulatory auditability
human_failure_condition: a truncated or mis-edited amount in a financial report
behavioral_entry_point: run CBL0006 (conditional totals) and CBL0033 on the same data; corrupt one COMP-3 field in a copy of the data and watch the report

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run cobol-programming-course-omp
nyx_handoff.what_humans_used_it_for: process fixed-format business records -- accounts, balances, limits, payroll -- in batch and print formatted reports, exactly as mainframe shops have since the 1960s
